item.title: Despite the constant ‘job apocalypse’ warnings, computer science graduates are actually on track to earn $81,000 right out of college
item.description: New data suggests that fears about the demise of computer science majors may be overblown—with demand outpacing MBAs and starting salaries growing year over year.

item.title: Forget the STEM safety net. Peter Thiel warns AI is a bigger threat to technical roles than to creative thinkers
item.description: A new LinkedIn report supports some of the billionaire’s predictions, showing that job postings mentioning “storytellers” doubled over the past year.

item.title: Trump claims America is ‘winning so much.’ The IMF agrees, adding that Trump’s trade policies are the only thing holding it back from even more
item.description: The best time to chip away at the national debt and balance the budget is now, when the economy is strong, says the IMF. Trump’s trade tariffs are making that difficult.

item.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei says he spends up to 40% of his time on company culture, not products, because it’s the only thing that will win the AI race
item.description: Amodei said constant communication and avoiding “corpo speak” are key to his method.

item.title: Remote employees have quietly unlocked one major workplace perk: Getting paid 12% more than their in-office colleagues, Fed study finds
item.description: The biggest remote-work winners in France are already high-paid senior employees able to persuade their bosses to let them stay home, new research reveals.

item.title: Citadel Securities demolishes viral AI doomsday essay, arguing the real ‘Global Intelligence Crisis’ is ignorance of macro fundamentals
